entry.text: CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable intelligent retrieval of clinical guidelines,
healthcare policies, provider documentation, member resources, care management information, and
enterprise knowledge repositories.
• Developed semantic search solutions using ChromaDB and embedding-based retrieval techniques to
deliver accurate, context-aware search capabilities across clinical documents, provider resources,
member information, healthcare policies, and operational knowledge bases.
• Engineered scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines using PySpark, Azure Data Factory
(ADF), Databricks Delta Lake, and SSIS to process large-scale healthcare, member, provider, clinical,
operational, and analytics datasets.

techniques to improve AI response accuracy, clinical insights, retrieval performance, and adherence to
healthcare compliance standards.

assistance, provider support, care coordination, clinical documentation assistance, healthcare inquiries,
and internal operational workflows.
• Developed secure RESTful APIs and AI-powered healthcare applications using Python and FastAPI,
integrating Generative AI capabilities with healthcare platforms, member applications, provider portals,
care management systems, and enterprise applications.
• Evaluated and optimized AI application performance using RAGAS, Cross-Encoder Re-ranking, Maximum
